issue.title: Play, record, and re-record audio Audit
issue.body:
Audit the Play, record, and re-record audio against related GitHub issues and expected behavior. Test the latest supported mobile build, document results, and create `dev ready` issues for any identified gaps.

**Done when:** The assessment is merged, all gaps are linked to actionable issues, and the audit result is posted to this sub-ticket.

comments.body:
## Play, record, and re-record audio audit — result

**Overall:** Pass with gaps

**Assessment PR:** https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/566

**Assessment (on the branch until merge):** `docs/assessments/play-record-rerecord-audio/README.md`

**Build / env:** local run of merged `main` @ `d5b9e64` (`expo-dev-client` + Metro) against `dev.api.fluent.bible`
**Device:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), physical device

**Summary:** The core flows work: record, pause, resume (including after a screen lock), stop, multi-take playback, select, delete, the 5-take cap, All Takes and canonical, pericope capture and stitching, and offline use. The main risk is **losing in-progress recordings** (Gaps 1–2), which should be decided on as launch blockers.

**Gaps:**

| Gap | Finding | Severity | Launch blocker | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | No background auto-pause and no kill-safe recovery; the in-progress take is lost | High | To be decided with product | #567 |
| 2 | The drawer (Settings, account switch, Add User, Sign Out) bypasses the capture guard and discards the take | High | To be decided with product | #568 |
| 3 | `Maximum update depth exceeded` when switching takes or tapping the waveform (regression of #298) | Medium | No | #569 |
| 4 | A waveform tap auto-plays while the control stays on Play | Medium | No | added to #544 |
| 5 | Stitched take row waveform and timer are misaligned | Low | No | #571 |
| 6 | The leave guard is OK-only, with no Resume/Discard option (#49) | Low | No | #570 |

Will update this comment with the merged assessment link after #566 merges.

## Play, record, and re-record audio audit — tests executed

These are the tests run to reach the results and gaps in this audit.

All tests were run on a physical Android device with access to Wi-Fi and mobile data.

### A. Permission and initial state

- **A.1** With microphone permission denied for the app, open a verse with no takes on the Record tab and tap Record. Expected: an explanation that the microphone is required, with a "Go to Settings" button that opens the app's permission settings.
- **A.2** Allow the microphone, return to the app, check the Idle state, then tap Record. Expected: enlarged "Record <reference>" button and no waveform before recording; recording starts after the tap.

### B. Recording

- **B.3** While recording, check the recording controls. Expected: the timer increments in real time, the waveform stays centered with the controls, and Pause and Stop are shown.
- **B.4** Pause, wait 10 seconds, then Resume. Expected: recording continues into the same take with no audio error.
- **B.5** Pause, lock the screen for about 30 seconds, unlock, then Resume. Expected: recording continues into the same take with no audio error.
- **B.6** While recording, press Home, wait 30 seconds, then return to the app. Expected: the take is automatically paused.
- **B.7a** With a take paused, try to leave: next/previous verse, switch to the Bible tab, header back, Android back, the Sync icon, and account switch. Expected: leaving is intercepted with a Resume or Discard prompt.
- **B.7b** With a take paused, swipe open the drawer, go to Settings, then back to Home. Expected: leaving is intercepted and the in-progress take is not lost.
- **B.8** Tap Stop. Expected: Take 1 appears in the list and is selected, and the verse does not auto-advance.

### C. Playback

- **C.9–10** Play Take 1 to the end, then play it again and pause mid-take. Expected: the Pause icon shows while playing, the real duration and advancing time are shown, playback resets to the start at the end, and Pause stops playback.
- **C.11** Tap the middle of the take's waveform. Expected: playback moves to the tapped position.

### D. Multiple takes

- **D.12** Tap "Record New Take" and record Take 2. Expected: the take list collapses while recording, and after Stop, Take 2 is appended to the list and selected.
- **D.13** Play Take 1, then Take 2 while Take 1 is playing, alternating about five times. Expected: only one take plays at a time, with no slowdown or update-depth error.
- **D.14** Tap the selection circle of an older take. Expected: that take becomes selected, and only one take is selected.
- **D.15** Delete a non-selected take. Expected: it is removed immediately, with no confirmation.
- **D.16** Record another take, then delete the selected take. Expected: a confirmation is shown, then another take becomes selected.
- **D.17** Record a take after deleting others. Expected: take numbering is cumulative and never reuses a deleted number.
- **D.18** Record until the verse has five takes. Expected: "Record New Take" is disabled.
- **D.19** With five takes, expand Source Text and scroll. Expected: the whole page scrolls as one, and the verse navigation bar stays pinned at the top.
- **D.20** On a second verse, record one take, then delete it. Expected: the verse returns to the Idle state with the enlarged Record button.

### E. Force-closed app

- **E.21–22** Record for about 10 seconds, pause, close the app from Recents, then relaunch it and return to the same verse. Expected: a prompt to recover the partial take (Resume or Discard).

### F. Second account

- **F.23** Switch to a second account and open a verse that the first account recorded. Expected: the My Takes / All Takes toggle is shown and defaults to My Takes.
- **F.24–26** Record a take with the second account, open All Takes, designate a take from the other account as canonical, then return to My Takes. Expected: takes are grouped by account with the account name, All Takes has no record or delete controls, only one take is canonical, and My Takes shows the canonical indicator as read-only.

### G. Pericope mode

- **G.27** Switch the Bible tab to Pericope mode, go to Record, and record a take. Expected: the title shows the verse range with the pericope title below it, and the take is labeled "Take N - Pericope - vv. X-Y".
- **G.28** Open a pericope where some verses were already recorded in verse mode and play the stitched row. Expected: a "Stitched" row is shown, and the verse takes play in order.

### H. Source audio

- **H.29** While source audio is playing, tap Record. Expected: the source audio stops before recording starts.

### I. Offline (airplane mode)

- **I.30** In airplane mode, record, play, select, and delete takes. Expected: all actions work offline.
- **I.31** Still offline, close and reopen the app and return to the verse. Expected: the takes are still listed and play normally.

## Play, record, and re-record audio audit complete — assessment merged

**Merged assessment:** https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/blob/main/docs/assessments/play-record-rerecord-audio/README.md
**Assessment PR:** #566 (merged)
**Result:** Pass with gaps

| Gap | Finding | Severity | Launch blocker | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | No background auto-pause or kill-safe recovery; the in-progress take is lost | High | To be decided with product | #567 |
| 2 | The drawer bypasses the capture guard and discards the take | High | To be decided with product | #568 |
| 3 | `Maximum update depth exceeded` during take playback (regression of #298) | Medium | No | #569 |
| 4 | A waveform tap auto-plays while the control stays on Play | Medium | No | #544 (comment) |
| 5 | Stitched take row waveform misaligned | Low | No | #571 |
| 6 | The leave guard is OK-only, with no Resume/Discard option | Low | No | #570 |

Offline recording and playback were also checked (I.30, I.31, both Pass); they are listed in the Offline and Synchronization table.

**Severity update:** Gap 6 (#570) is Low; the merged README still says "Low / Medium". Navigation is blocked and no data is lost; the translator has to keep and then delete an unwanted take.

## Play, record, and re-record audio — retest

> **Note:** this test script was generated with the help of AI, from the tests executed in the #528 audit (epic #526) and from other information gathered while the issues were implemented. It is a guide, not a limit: any other test that covers these points or goes beyond them is also valid.

> **Linked issues:** when a test ends with an issue number in parentheses, for example `(#567)` at the end of B.6, that is the sub-issue that fixed that point, so you can open it to see what was changed. Some of these issues are still open or depend on work that is not finished yet (for example, fluent-api changes). Those tests are marked with "issue still open" or "may fail". For them, a failure may be expected for now: report what you see, but it does not necessarily mean the fix regressed.

A "take" is each recording made for a verse. All tests are on the **Record** tab of the chapter screen.

**What to prepare:** a **physical** Android phone (the #707 problem does not show on the emulator); two accounts with access to the same project; a project with pericopes (e.g. Mark 1); a project with source audio. Always use **new recordings**: takes recorded before the #707 fix stay silent, and that is expected.

### A. Permission and starting screen

- [ ] **A.1** In Android settings, deny microphone permission for Fluent. In the app, open a verse with no recordings on the Record tab and tap Record. Expected: a message says the microphone is required, with a "Go to Settings" button; tapping it opens Fluent's permission screen in Android.
- [ ] **A.2** Allow the microphone, return to the app and look at the screen before recording. Expected: a large "Record <verse>" button and no audio wave. Tapping the button starts recording.

### B. Recording

- [ ] **B.3** While recording, look at the controls. Expected: the timer counts up in real time, the audio wave moves in the center, and Pause and Stop buttons are shown.
- [ ] **B.4** Tap Pause, wait 10 seconds and tap to continue. Expected: recording continues in the same take, with no error message.
- [ ] **B.5** Pause, lock the phone screen for about 30 seconds, unlock and continue. Expected: recording continues in the same take, with no error.
- [ ] **B.6** While recording, press the Android Home button, wait 30 seconds and return to the app. Expected: the recording is paused (it did not keep recording in the background). (#567)
- [ ] **B.7a** With a paused recording, try to leave in each of these ways: next/previous verse arrows, Bible tab, back arrow at the top, Android back button, cloud icon, and account switch. Expected: every time, a question appears with **Resume** or **Discard**. (#570)
- [ ] **B.7b** With a paused recording, swipe from the left edge to open the side menu, tap Settings, then go back to Home. Expected: the app asks before leaving (or does not let the menu open), and the recording is not lost. (#568)
- [ ] **B.7c** On the B.7a question, tap **Resume**. Expected: you stay on the same verse with the recording paused; you can keep recording and tap Stop, and the take is saved. (#570)
- [ ] **B.7d** Record again, pause, try to go to the next verse and tap **Discard**. Expected: the app goes to the next verse; going back to the previous verse, the discarded recording does not show as a take, and the verse is as it was before. (#570)
- [ ] **B.7e** With a paused recording, try from the side menu: switch account, **Add User** and **Sign Out**. Expected: each time the app blocks or asks first, and the recording is not lost without you choosing. (#568)
- [ ] **B.8** Tap Stop. Expected: "Take 1" appears in the list, already selected, and the app stays on the same verse.
- [ ] **B.9** With media volume up, play the take you just recorded. Expected: you can hear the recording (it is not silent). (#707)
- [ ] **B.10** Record about 5 seconds, pause, record about 5 more and tap Stop. Expected: a single take of about 10 seconds that plays both parts with sound, with no gap. (#567, #707)
- [ ] **B.11** Record a short take (about 2 seconds) and a long one (about 60 seconds). Expected: both play from start to end, with sound. (#707)

### C. Playback

- [ ] **C.9–10** Play Take 1 to the end; then play it again and pause in the middle. Expected: a pause icon shows while playing; the real length and the running time are shown; at the end it goes back to the start; Pause stops the sound.
- [ ] **C.11a** With the take **stopped**, tap the middle of the audio wave. Expected: the position moves to the middle and the audio does **not** start playing on its own; tapping Play starts from the middle. (#544, #707)
- [ ] **C.11b** With the take **playing**, tap near the end of the wave, then near the start. Expected: the audio jumps to each point and keeps playing, with sound; the button keeps showing Pause; the app does not freeze or slow down. (#544, #569)
- [ ] **C.12** Drag your finger along the wave. Expected: the position follows your finger, and the audio continues from where you let go. (#707)
- [ ] **C.13** On a take of about 60 seconds, while playing, quickly tap 8 to 10 different spots on the wave. Expected: it keeps playing from the last spot; the app does not freeze and no error screen appears. (#569, #707)

### D. Several takes

- [ ] **D.12** Tap "Record New Take" and record Take 2. Expected: the take list collapses while recording; after Stop, Take 2 appears at the end of the list, selected.
- [ ] **D.13** Play Take 1 and, while it plays, play Take 2; switch about five times. Expected: only one take plays at a time, each button shows the right icon, and the app does not freeze, slow down or close. (#569)
- [ ] **D.14** Tap the selection circle of an older take. Expected: that take is selected, and only one is selected.
- [ ] **D.15** Delete a take that is not selected. Expected: it disappears at once, with no confirmation.
- [ ] **D.16** Record another take and delete the selected take. Expected: the app asks for confirmation; then another take becomes selected, and the remaining takes still play.
- [ ] **D.17** After deleting some takes, record a new one. Expected: the number keeps counting (e.g. after Take 3 was deleted, the next is Take 4) and never repeats a number already used.
- [ ] **D.18** Record until the verse has five takes. Expected: the "Record New Take" button is disabled.
- [ ] **D.19** With five takes, open "Source Text" and scroll. Expected: the whole page scrolls together, and the verse navigation bar stays fixed at the top.
- [ ] **D.20** On another verse, record a take and delete it. Expected: the screen goes back to the starting state, with the large Record button.

### E. App force-closed

- [ ] **E.21–22** Record about 5 seconds and pause. Open Android's recent apps and swipe Fluent away. Open the app again and return to the same verse. Expected: the app asks whether to recover the recording (Resume or Discard), with the timer at about 0:05. Tap Resume, record about 5 more seconds and Stop: the take is about 10 seconds and plays both parts with sound. (#567, #707)
- [ ] **E.23** Repeat E.21–22, but tap **Discard** on recovery. Expected: the recording disappears, and the earlier takes are still in the list and still play. (#567)
- [ ] **E.24** Record about 5 seconds and, **without pausing**, close the app from recent apps. Open it again, recover the recording and tap Stop. Expected: the recording is recovered and plays with sound. (#567, #707)

### F. Second account

- [ ] **F.23** Switch to a second account and open a verse the first account recorded. Expected: the **My Takes / All Takes** option appears, starting on My Takes.
- [ ] **F.24–26** With the second account, record a take; open All Takes; mark a take from the other account as the main (canonical) one; go back to My Takes. Expected: in All Takes, takes are grouped under each account's name, with no record or delete buttons; only one take is marked as main; in My Takes the main mark is shown but cannot be changed.

### G. Pericope mode

- [ ] **G.27** In Settings, set "Drafting unit" to **Pericope**. In the chapter, go to Record and record a take. Expected: the title shows the verse range (e.g. 1–5) with the pericope name below it, and the take is shown as "Take N - Pericope - vv. X-Y".
- [ ] **G.28** Open a pericope where some verses were already recorded one by one (in Verse mode) and play the "Stitched" row. Expected: a "Stitched" row is shown with its wave and time lined up with the other rows, and the verses play in sequence, with sound. Tapping the middle of that row's wave goes to the right verse. (#571, #707)

### H. Source audio

- [ ] **H.29** While the source audio is playing, tap Record. Expected: the source audio stops before recording starts.

### I. Offline (airplane mode)

- [ ] **I.30** In airplane mode, record, play, select and delete takes. Expected: everything works without internet.
- [ ] **I.31** Still in airplane mode, close the app, open it again and return to the verse. Expected: the takes are still there and play normally.
